definitions.explanation: To go past each other from opposite directions.
To fail to meet or understand each other.

notes:
すれ{違|ちが}う means to pass by each other or to miss each other (physically or figuratively).

TRANSITIVITY:
Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)

PHYSICAL MEANING:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧すれ{違|ちが}う: to pass each other on the street
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すれ{違|ちが}う: trains pass each other

FIGURATIVE MEANING:
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すれ{違|ちが}う: feelings don't connect
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すれ{違|ちが}う: talking past each other
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧すれ{違|ちが}う: opinions don't match

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦すれ{違|ちが}い→すれ違い：09910_surechigai⟧ (noun): passing, miscommunication
